title: Daily digest: Malkajgiri Traffic Police Issue Advisory | Telangana Govt issues order to register  | Hyderabad businessman arrested for claim
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Malkajgiri traffic police issued an advisory on Ganesh idol height limits.
Telangana Govt issues order to register Section 22-A properties with valid approvals.
Hyderabad businessman arrested for claiming rs 32.28 crore ITC using bogus invoices.
bullets_ur: Malkajgiri Traffic Police ne Ganesh murtiyon ki unchai ki seemaon par salah jari kar di.
Telangana Sarkar ne dhara 22-A jaidadon mein sahi aavedanon par registration ka aadesh diya.
Police ne ek case ke silsile mein ek mulzim ko giraftaar kar liya.
